text:
Everything you learned about goals came from people who gave up on theirs.

They told you to dream big and hope. Hope is for losers.

Your subconscious mind works like a machine. Feed it ONE specific goal on repeat. Write it. Say it every morning. Every night before bed.

Your brain doesn't stop. It processes that goal while you sleep. It finds the actions. It turns the goal into reality.

But only if you're specific. Vague thinking produces vague results.

Start today. One goal. Write it. Repeat it daily.
caption:
Most people fail at goals because they never plant them specifically in their subconscious mind.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
